phase_name: Manual fidelity adjudication -- the two OCR-degraded entries

objectives.description: Manual read gate: hand-read at least 4 chunk_*.md files per document, spread across the document, partly different from research's spread
Assess rutten-2000-universal-coalgebra: prose recoverability, notation-vs-prose scope of degradation, quoted excerpts
Assess reynolds-2003-ockhamist: systematic dropped-letter pattern affecting prose and title, quoted excerpts
Record explicitly that rutten's Zotero PDF must not be used to assess conversion fidelity (Decision 2)
Capture doc_type evidence for both from the same reads
Append both rows to data/adjudication.tsv; write progress/phase-3-progress.json

enum_adequacy_decision.question: Can the corpus's existing six-value provenance_fidelity enum (verified_conversion, no_source_pdf, unverified_no_baseline, unadjudicated, not_yet_converted, unverified_conversion) express the systematic dropped-letter-c symptom found on hand read?
enum_adequacy_decision.decision: No value fits exactly. unverified_conversion is selected as the nearest existing value, per Decision 3's mandate to select-nearest-and-record rather than invent a new value.
enum_adequacy_decision.reasoning: The task 457 Phase 6 precedent used unverified_conversion for entries where 'prose is coherent, formulas degraded' (confirmed against the corpus: the two Jonsson-Tarski 1951/1952 entries carry this exact value from that precedent). reynolds-2003-ockhamist is worse than that precedent: prose itself requires active decoding on nearly every line because the OCR pass appears to have systematically dropped every instance of the letter 'c' throughout the document, including in the paper's own title ('O khamist Logi of Histori al Ne essity' for 'Ockhamist Logic of Historical Necessity'). The remaining five enum values were considered and rejected as worse fits: no_source_pdf and not_yet_converted are factually false (a source clearly was converted); unadjudicated is now false (this phase IS the adjudication); unverified_no_baseline describes an inability to verify due to a missing comparison baseline, not a judgment that adjudication occurred and found degradation -- reynolds was read and judged, the degradation just exceeds the label's implicit severity ceiling. unverified_conversion remains nearest because it is the only value in the corpus vocabulary that denotes 'a conversion occurred and is not being certified as clean', which is true here even though the degree of non-cleanliness is more severe than the precedent's use of the same label.
enum_adequacy_decision.gap_flagged_for_summary: The corpus's six-value provenance_fidelity enum has no way to distinguish 'formulas degraded, prose coherent' from 'prose itself substantially degraded but still human-decodable' -- both currently collapse onto unverified_conversion. This is a genuine vocabulary gap, not a data error, and is flagged here for the implementation summary per Decision 3 rather than resolved by widening the enum (out of scope for a data-only migration task).

decision_2_reminder: rutten-2000-universal-coalgebra has a locatable Zotero PDF at ~/Documents/Zotero/storage/2T5LMRXA/Rutten - 2000 - Universal coalgebra a theory of systems.pdf (confirmed to exist in Phase 4). Per Decision 2, this Zotero copy is NOT the PDF that was originally chunked -- chunking predates any Zotero linkage in this corpus -- so it was NOT opened or compared against the chunk text during this phase's provenance_fidelity assessment. The unverified_conversion verdict above rests exclusively on the hand read of the eight rutten chunk_*.md files listed in data/adjudication.tsv. The Zotero PDF is reserved for Phase 4's source_format grounding only.
notes: Both entries confirm the research's OCR-degraded classification. rutten's degradation, independently sampled with a broader and partly-different chunk spread than the research used, was found to be more pervasive across ordinary prose (not just the four symptom points the research named) though meaning remains recoverable throughout with effort. reynolds' systematic dropped-c pattern was confirmed exactly as described, including the title-level corruption; the enum-adequacy decision above is the recorded deliverable this phase requires.
